antcolonies.configuration.adultLifespanM: Average minutes an adult ant lives. A colony without a Queen dwindles; with one, eggs replace the dead.
antcolonies.configuration.ant3DModels.to: Draw the ants on top of a Formicarium as 3D models up close. False draws them as 2D sprites like the ants in the tunnels: they look flatter but cost far less, which helps with many colonies in view.
antcolonies.configuration.antCost.toolti: Ants a colony gives up for one Guard Ant (a Rally Pheromone used on its Formicarium).
antcolonies.configuration.antDetailDista: Blocks within which the ants on top of a Formicarium are 3D models (if ant3DModels is on); further away (where they are a pixel or two) they are 2D sprites, which are far cheaper to draw.
antcolonies.configuration.anthillAlarmSe: Seconds an anthill stays alarmed at a player who opened one of its chests, stepped into its Queen's chamber or struck one of its ants (even in a full Chitin set, its ants attack them meanwhile).
antcolonies.configuration.anthillCrowdRa: Blocks around a Larva Cluster in which wild ants count towards anthillMaxAnts.
antcolonies.configuration.anthillMaxAnts: A Larva Cluster waits to hatch while this many wild ants or more are within anthillCrowdRange blocks of it.
antcolonies.configuration.baseEggsPerMin: Eggs a Queen with average genetics lays per minute with one Nest Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.baseMutationCh: Chance a daughter Queen is born with a random mutation (before Mutation Probability).
Stacked bonuses (genetics x mutations x upgrades) above 1 count as bonus^exponent, so they can't multiply without end. 1 = no softening; 0.6 turns x20 into x6.
antcolonies.configuration.broodClusterMi: Minutes, on average, an anthill's Ant Egg Cluster takes to become a Larva Cluster, and a Larva Cluster to become 1 to 3 ants (only clusters an anthill was built with, and only while a player is near enough for the chunk to tick).
antcolonies.configuration.catchUpDistanc: A following Guard Ant this many blocks from its owner catches up at once.
antcolonies.configuration.centrifugeEner: Multiplier on the FE every Droplet Centrifuge recipe takes (the recipes are data: data/<namespace>/recipe/*.json, type antcolonies:centrifuging).
antcolonies.configuration.centrifugePush: Most millibuckets a Droplet Centrifuge gives per tick to the tanks and pipes touching it (0: it only lets them take). What they take out by themselves has no limit.
antcolonies.configuration.centrifugeTank: Millibuckets of fluid a Droplet Centrifuge's tank holds.
antcolonies.configuration.centrifugeTime: Multiplier on the time every Droplet Centrifuge recipe takes.
antcolonies.configuration.chamberBaseCap: Ants one Foraging Site, Harvesting Site or Hunting Ground takes before Population Upgrades.
antcolonies.configuration.chamberCapacit: Ants each Population Upgrade tier adds to one of those sites.
antcolonies.configuration.chitinFindChan: Chance per Foraging Site find that the ants also bring back chitin (shed and left by ants): Chitin Plates, Hardened Chitin from colony stage 2 (more at stage 3), Infernal Chitin in the Nether, Void Chitin in the End. 0 turns it off.
antcolonies.configuration.clusterBrood.t: Eggs (Ant Egg Cluster) or larvae (Larva Cluster) one brood cluster from an anthill gives a colony of its species.
antcolonies.configuration.connectorRange: How far apart two Colony Connectors may be and still link: at most this many blocks apart on x and on z (height doesn't count). Connectors further apart on the same channel don't trade.
antcolonies.configuration.detailedColony: The Formicarium screen in Detailed Mode (exact numbers, rates per minute, efficiency) instead of Visual Mode (pictures, bars and short notes). The screen's mode button switches it and remembers the choice here.
antcolonies.configuration.dropletRolls.t: Liquid Chambers: droplets per minute per effective Liquid Ant, before the species' own rate (the "liquid" part of data/<namespace>/antcolonies/species/*.json).
antcolonies.configuration.eggHatchMinute: Average minutes until an egg hatches into a larva.
antcolonies.configuration.expeditionRoll: Nether and End Foraging Sites: expedition finds per minute per effective worker, before the expedition's own rate (data/<namespace>/antcolonies/expedition/*.json).
antcolonies.configuration.experience.too: Experience from kills, compared to the normal amount.
antcolonies.configuration.experienceGrow: How fast the experience a level takes grows: level to this power, times experienceBase.
antcolonies.configuration.farmerByproduc: Garden harvests (mushrooms, seeds, berries) per minute per effective farmer.
antcolonies.configuration.farmerFood.too: Food per minute per effective farmer, before the species' own food production.
antcolonies.configuration.feedingMakesLa: Whether feeding a Formicarium still evolves a colony into a species that has a research entry (the mineral and endgame species). Off: those are made only in the Genetic Laboratory, once researched.
antcolonies.configuration.firstNestCatch: A player's first catch from each kind of wild nest is always a Queen. Later catches from that kind use nestQueenChance.
antcolonies.configuration.focusedForagin: Foraging Site modes: how much more often a Mineral or Organic Gathering site picks the finds of its kind (item tag antcolonies:foraging/mineral; everything else is organic).
Foraging Site modes: how often a focused site still picks the finds of the other kind (1 = as often as Balanced).
antcolonies.configuration.followsThrough: Whether a following Guard Ant near its owner goes through portals with them.
antcolonies.configuration.foodUpgradeSav: Share of food saved per Food Efficiency Upgrade tier (at most 75% in total).
antcolonies.configuration.foundingFoodSh: Queen-only founding (a single Queen put into a completely empty Formicarium): the share of the Formicarium's own food room (terrariumFoodCapacity) the player must fill before the Queen lays her first eggs. 1 = a full food bar. Colonies started or moved with workers, eggs or larvae never need this.
antcolonies.configuration.foundingWorker: Adults a founding Queen's first brood must raise before the colony counts as founded and runs like any other.
antcolonies.configuration.generatorOutpu: FE a Generator makes per tick while it burns fuel (one coal burns for 1600 ticks).
Most FE a Generator gives to the blocks around it per tick.
antcolonies.configuration.homeNestAnts.t: Ants living in a home nest (the wild nests a player places).
antcolonies.configuration.homeNestRefill: Minutes a home nest takes to raise a new ant after one of its ants died.
antcolonies.configuration.hungryFoodWork: The least speed of the jobs that bring food in (Harvesting Sites and Hunting Grounds) while food is low or out, so a hungry colony can always feed itself again.
antcolonies.configuration.huntFood.toolt: Food a colony gets from each mob its hunters catch (they feed on it).
antcolonies.configuration.huntRolls.tool: Simulated hunts per minute per effective hunter, before hunting strength.
antcolonies.configuration.hunter.tooltip: Food an ant hunting at a Hunting Ground eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.hunterCasualty: Chance a hunt costs one hunter, before the hunters' strength.
antcolonies.configuration.hybridQualityB: How much of a hybrid's chance is added for each trait level the two Queens average above the cross's level (0.15 = 15% more a level; 0 = better traits do not raise the chance).
antcolonies.configuration.hybridWeakChan: Share of a hybrid's chance left when every trait of both Queens is at level 1; it grows to the whole chance at the cross's trait level (1 = weak traits do not cut the chance).
antcolonies.configuration.idleActivity.t: How much an ant without a job eats, compared to a busy one.
antcolonies.configuration.inheritanceVar: Chance per trait that a daughter Queen's level differs by one from her mother's.
antcolonies.configuration.interval.toolt: Ticks between colony simulation steps. Larger steps cost less and give the same totals.
antcolonies.configuration.labCostMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory material costs (rounded up, at least 1).
antcolonies.configuration.labEnergyInput: Most FE a Genetic Laboratory takes in per tick.
antcolonies.configuration.labTimeMultipl: Multiplier on Genetic Laboratory processing times.
antcolonies.configuration.larva.tooltip: Food a larva eats per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.larvaeGrowMinu: Average minutes until a larva becomes an adult (before genetics and Nest Chambers).
antcolonies.configuration.liquidFoodChan: Chance that a droplet comes with one Ant Food as well. Keep it small: Farmer Ants are the colony's food makers. 0 turns it off.
Work, egg laying and growth speed of a colony whose food is just about gone (but not yet starving).
antcolonies.configuration.lowFoodMinutes: Below this many minutes of food left (food / what the colony eats per minute), a colony works, lays and raises its larvae more slowly, down to lowFoodFactor when the food runs out (0 turns this off; starving uses starvedFactor).
antcolonies.configuration.maintenanceFra: Share of a colony's adults that must stay home to clean the nest and tend the brood. Workers kept for maintenance are never assigned to a job; too few of them lower colony health.
antcolonies.configuration.maxBeneficialM: Most beneficial mutations one Queen can carry (flaws don't count).
antcolonies.configuration.maxChambers.to: Most chambers one colony takes. Touching chambers beyond it (the furthest from the Formicarium) don't join.
antcolonies.configuration.maxColonyPopul: Hard cap on the adults of one colony, whatever its housing.
antcolonies.configuration.maxFoodPerMinu: Most food one Colony Connector moves per minute (its own setting can be lower).
antcolonies.configuration.maxItemsPerMin: Most items one sending Colony Connector moves out of its colony's Storage per minute.
antcolonies.configuration.maxLevel.toolt: The highest level a Guard Ant reaches.
antcolonies.configuration.maxLevelMultip: Effect of a trait at the maximum level.
antcolonies.configuration.maxPerPlayer.t: Guard Ants one player may have out in the world at once (those in tubes do not count). 0: any number.

antcolonies.configuration.nestChamberLar: Larvae each Nest Chamber holds on top of the Formicarium's own room.
antcolonies.configuration.nestCropGrowth: Chance per tick that an ant from a home nest, standing at a crop or sapling, grows it a stage (0 turns tending off).
antcolonies.configuration.nestGrowthBonu: Larvae growth speed added by each Nest Chamber (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.nestHarvest.to: Ants from a home nest harvest ripe crops around it, replant them and carry the harvest into the nest.
antcolonies.configuration.nestLayingBonu: Egg laying added by each Nest Chamber after the first (diminishing).
antcolonies.configuration.nestQueenChanc: Chance Tweezers pull a Queen instead of workers from a wild nest.
antcolonies.configuration.nestRecoverySe: Seconds a nest needs until its ants are back after Tweezers took some. Ten minutes by default.
antcolonies.configuration.noNestChamberF: Egg laying speed of a Queen without any Nest Chamber.
antcolonies.configuration.offlineCatchUp: Minutes of simulation a colony catches up on when its Formicarium loads again after being unloaded. Production never runs while unloaded; this is the most it can make up afterwards (0 = none).
antcolonies.configuration.populationExpo: Diminishing returns: n ants on one kind of job (all of a colony's sites of that kind together) work like n^exponent ants.
antcolonies.configuration.preferredItemM: Mod ids, in order. When several mods add the item of a find (tin nuggets in a big pack), ants bring the one of the first mod listed here that has it. With none of these mods in the pack, they bring the one of the mod the game loaded first.

antcolonies.configuration.queenChance.to: Chance a naturally spawned wild ant is a Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.queenGrowthCap: Highest level growing can raise a Queen's trait to (the Genetic Laboratory can go further, up to maxTraitLevel).
antcolonies.configuration.queenGrowthMin: A Queen grows with her colony: minutes her colony must spend at a bigger stage before she grows into it, times the step (stage 2 takes this, stage 3 twice this, stage 4 three times). Each new stage raises two of her traits.
antcolonies.configuration.queenGrowthTra: Traits that go up by one each time a Queen grows into a bigger stage.
antcolonies.configuration.queenRearingMi: Adults a colony needs before its Queen Chamber can raise a new Queen.
antcolonies.configuration.rareFindMultip: Multiplier on the chance of every rare ("special") find: diamonds, netherite scrap, shells, sponges, sniffer eggs... 0.5 halves them, 0 turns them off, 2 doubles them. antcolonies.configuration.stagePopulatio: Adults a colony needs for stages 2, 3 and 4 (stage 4 also needs a mineral or better species, or average genetics of 5 or more).

gui.antcolonies.lab.page.analysis.help:
Shows the Queen in the slot on the left. Her genes: how far she has grown,
and each of her mutations with what it does. Under that, what she can become.
A check: she is ready. A yellow dot: something is still missing.
A green dot: a natural change, made by feeding her Formicarium.
Looking at her here records her in the Ant Identification Book.
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.analysis.strip: What this Queen is and what she can become
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.editing.help:
Changes the Queen's genes, as before.
Upgrade: click a trait, put its materials in, press Upgrade.
Reroll, Mutate and Purge take an item from the catalyst slot.
Copy puts her genes into an empty Test Tube.
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.hybrid.help:
A hybrid is the daughter of two species, raised in a Queen Chamber.
1. Put a Queen of one species here, and an empty Test Tube below.
2. Press Copy genes: you get her Genetic Sample.
3. Put the sample in the Queen Chamber of a colony of the other species.
4. Each daughter raised there may be the hybrid. The listed chance is for two Queens at the listed trait level: higher traits raise it, lower ones cut it.
The list shows the crosses whose two species you have both met.
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.hybrid.strip: Copy genes here for a cross in a Queen Chamber
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.mutation.help:
Turns the Queen into another species.
1. Research that species' material on the Research page.
2. Put a Queen of the right species, grown enough, in the slot on the left.
3. Choose the species, put the materials in the two slots, press Mutate.
It always works. She keeps her traits, mutations and name.
Back in her Formicarium, her colony keeps its ants.
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.mutation.strip: Choose a species, add its materials, press Mutate
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.research.help:
The laboratory's scanner. Put a material in the scanner slot and press Scan.
The right material reveals a species mutation or a gene, for good.
The material is not used up. A Test Tube of ants records their species.
The list shows what you have found. What is still unknown is in the book.
gui.antcolonies.lab.page.stability.help:
For breeding. It fixes what a Queen's daughters inherit in a Queen Chamber.
Trait: click it and press Stabilize. Every daughter gets exactly that level.
Mutation: click it on the right. Her Genetic Sample then always passes it on.
The Stability % is the chance that a daughter's new flaw is dropped.
It changes nothing in her own colony, and nothing else needs it.
Release undoes it for free.

guide.antcolonies.automation.text:
Hoppers and pipes can feed the Formicarium and Queen Chambers, and empty Storage and Foraging Sites. A Storage with an Automation Upgrade pushes its finds into the container under it.
Comparators read a Formicarium's food, a site's workforce, or how full a store is. A redstone signal pauses a site: its ants go elsewhere.
guide.antcolonies.automation.title: Automation
guide.antcolonies.building.text:
No two anthills are dug alike: each nest grows room by room, small, medium or large, with nurseries, food stores, fungus gardens, aphid farms, middens to brush, barracks and treasure chambers, side entrances, loops and dead ends. Their look follows the biome: termite spires in savannas and badlands, a crater in the desert, a thatched dome in the taiga, snow, moss or mud elsewhere. The Nether and the End have anthills too.
Deepest of all, behind her Royal Guard Ants, lies the great Queen. In a full Chitin set the ants let you pass, until you open one of their chests, step into her chamber or strike one of them: then the whole anthill attacks.
Its Ant Egg Clusters become Larva Clusters, and those, in time, 1 to 3 more of its ants. Taken with Silk Touch, a cluster goes into the Formicarium of a working colony of the same species; placed again, it is only a decoration.
Their walls are Anthill Soil. From it, Chitin Plates, Ant Resin (Wood Ants find it), mushrooms and Royal Jelly come five families of building blocks, with stairs, slabs and walls, a Nest Door and a Pheromone Lamp.
guide.antcolonies.building.title: Anthills and Building
guide.antcolonies.chambers.text:
Chambers are additions. Put one against the Formicarium, or against a chamber already in the colony, on any side (above and below too): it joins, and the glass between them goes: the whole build becomes one glass case. A colony takes up to 32.
Build upward and the colony becomes an upright nest: once more of its blocks are stacked (one right over another) than stand flat on the ground, every block shows its own chamber, carved into the earth between a glass at the front and one at the back, and tunnels join it to the blocks beside, above and below. With as many stacked as flat it stays as it was; with more flat ones it is glass cases again. A tower or a wall of them is one nest, and the ants walk through all of it.
Nest Chamber: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae. Without one the Queen lays at half speed and only 60 adults fit.
Foraging Site: workers find the species' resources. It sends its finds to the Storage, and holds 9 stacks while the Storage is full.
Harvesting Site: Farmer Ants grow food and harvest there.
Hunting Ground: hunter species (Army Ants and the ants that evolve into hunters) kill mobs there: the mobs' loot, and food from what they catch.
Storage: more room for finds, and food room.
Queen Chamber: raises new Queens.
A chamber exactly as near to two Formicariums joins neither.
guide.antcolonies.chambers.title: The Colony Build
guide.antcolonies.climate.text:
Every species likes a climate: temperate, cold, hot, underground or nether. In the wrong one the colony loses health, less with good Environmental Resistance.
A block under the Formicarium fixes it: snow or ice make it cold, sand or sandstone hot, grass or dirt temperate, stone or deepslate underground, netherrack or magma nether. The Formicarium's Info page shows the blocks for your colony.
guide.antcolonies.climate.title: Climate
guide.antcolonies.companions.text:
A Rally Pheromone used on a wild ant makes it your Guard Ant; used on a Formicarium, the colony gives up ants for one of its species, as strong as its Queen's Hunting Strength. It keeps its species and looks, and grows.
Right-click it for its screen: a name, its level, what it wears and its orders. Sneak and right-click gives the next order: follow, stay, guard. It learns from every kill it lands itself, mends when it rests, and ant food heals it at once.
Ant Plates are its armor, a costume is only for looks, and an Ant Cart makes it carry nine stacks. An empty Test Tube picks it up with all it has. A tube opens only for its owner: craft it with a name tag to pass the ant on.
Use the pheromone in the air to see your Guard Ants and where they are, and to call one to you for a pheromone. It can die, and then leaves what it had.
guide.antcolonies.companions.title: Guard Ants
guide.antcolonies.connectors.text:
Connectors come in the mid game, after the Nether: one takes Infernal Chitin, a Nether Trail Pheromone, Blaze Rods and a Magma Block.
A Colony Connector joins a colony like any chamber. Connectors with the same channel colour in one dimension link their colonies when they are at most 30 blocks apart (on x and on z), as long as both are loaded.
Supply gives the food a colony has above its reserve; Request takes food up to its target, the hungriest colony first. Send moves the items in its filter out of the colony's Storage to colonies that Receive.
A Farmer colony supplying food lets mining and hunting colonies put more ants to work. The Formicarium's Network page shows the network.
guide.antcolonies.connectors.title: Colony Connectors
guide.antcolonies.evolution.text:
Some species adapt by themselves: feed the Formicarium the right material once the colony is big enough (the Info page lists it). A try may fail, but one always works after enough tries. An Evolution Catalyst helps.
Mineral and endgame species are not fed into being: they are species mutations, researched and then made in the Genetic Laboratory (see Genetic Research).
A Queen Chamber raises daughter Queens from the colony's Queen; with a Genetic Sample of another species it can raise a hybrid.
guide.antcolonies.evolution.title: Evolution
guide.antcolonies.expeditions.text:
Take a colony to the Nether (or the End) and let it forage there: now and then its Foraging Sites find a Nether (or End) Trail Pheromone.
Back home, build a Nether Foraging Site (obsidian, Infernal Chitin, a Foraging Site and two Nether Trail Pheromones) or an End Foraging Site (end stone bricks, Void Chitin, an eye of ender, a Foraging Site and two End Trail Pheromones).
Nether-adapted ants (Warped, Fire, Inferno, Soul, Netherite, Wither, Crimson) and End-adapted ants (Chorus, Ender, Dragon) then go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back that dimension's finds. Nothing really travels: no power and no chunk loading.
guide.antcolonies.expeditions.title: Expeditions
guide.antcolonies.food.text:
Ants eat. Food goes in the Formicarium's food slot (beside the feed slot), by hand, by right-clicking the Formicarium or from a hopper: Ant Food, Royal Jelly, sugar, sweet berries and other plain foods. The Formicarium holds 2,000 food; each Storage adds 25,000.
Mineral and crystal species need their own food for their eggs. A starving colony works slowly, then loses ants.
Farmer Ants at a Harvesting Site grow food themselves.
guide.antcolonies.food.title: Food
guide.antcolonies.founding.text:
Every anthill has a Queen to catch. Put her into a completely empty Formicarium on her own and she founds a colony: fill the food bar (ten Ant Food) and she lays her first eggs. When her first 10 workers are grown, the colony is founded.
Put her in with workers, eggs or larvae instead (or move a colony across in its tubes) and the colony runs at once: founding is only for a Queen alone.
Food keeps a colony working: with less than 10 minutes of food left it slows down, and with none it starves. Farmer Ants at Harvesting Sites grow food, and Colony Connectors bring it from other colonies.
guide.antcolonies.founding.title: Founding a Colony
guide.antcolonies.gear.text:
Chitin tools and armor come in four tiers. Chitin (from Chitin Plates) is iron level; Hardened is crafted the same way from Hardened Chitin and lasts three times as long.
Infernal: at a smithing table, a Hardened piece with an Infernal Reinforcement and an Infernal Chitin. Diamond level and fireproof. Void: an Infernal piece with a Void Reinforcement and a netherite ingot. Past netherite.
Reinforcements are crafted two at a time: Infernal from Infernal Chitin, blaze rods, magma cream and a ghast tear; Void from Void Chitin, shulker shells, popped chorus fruit and an eye of ender.
Any four chitin armor pieces are a full set: wild ants leave you alone, until you raid their anthill. The lowest tier you wear sets the rest: digging 20, 25, 30 or 40% faster, and from Infernal up Fire Resistance.
guide.antcolonies.gear.title: Chitin Gear
guide.antcolonies.genetics.text:
Each Queen has ten traits from 1 to 10, and daughters inherit them with small changes. Mutations add strengths, or flaws.
The Genetic Laboratory raises one trait at a time, rerolls, mutates and purges flaws on its Editing page. It runs on FE: put a Generator next to it, or any mod's cable.
Its Stabilization page is optional: a locked trait passes to her daughters exactly as it is, and a protected mutation always passes on when her genes are crossed in.
guide.antcolonies.genetics.title: Genetics
guide.antcolonies.jobs.text:
Workers go to Harvesting Sites and Hunting Grounds first (they bring food), then to Foraging Sites. A twentieth of the adults stay home to look after the nest.
Each site takes up to 256 ants, more with Population Upgrades. Its screen sets how many it wants; Auto takes all it can.
The more ants on a job, the more they find, a little less for each extra ant. Only Farmer species farm, and only hunter species hunt: the Info page says which.
guide.antcolonies.jobs.title: Jobs
guide.antcolonies.research.text:
The Genetic Laboratory has a scanner on its Research page. Put a material in its slot and press Scan: the right material reveals a species mutation or a gene, for good. The material stays in the slot, and scanning it again gains nothing.
A Test Tube of ants in the scanner records their species; a Queen in the lab's Queen slot is analysed on the Analysis page. Catching ants and opening a Formicarium record the species too.
A researched mutation is made in the Genetic Laboratory, on its Species Mutation page: a Queen of the right species who has grown with a big enough colony, the material, power, and for the rarer ones Evolution Catalysts. It always works. Take the Queen out of her Formicarium in a Test Tube and put her back afterwards: her ants stay and turn into the new species as they are replaced.
Research is yours. With FTB Teams, the members of a party share what they discover while they are in it.
guide.antcolonies.research.title: Genetic Research
guide.antcolonies.start.text:
Craft Tweezers and some Test Tubes. Find wild ants or an Ant Nest and use the Tweezers on them: the ants go into an empty Test Tube in your inventory. Your first catch from a nest is always a Queen. After that Queens are rare; nests give one now and then.
Place a Formicarium, put the Queen Test Tube in, then some Ant Food. The Queen starts laying eggs at once: a Formicarium works on its own.
The Formicarium's screen shows the colony: its ants, genes, jobs and numbers, and on the Info page what its ants are like.
To move a colony, take it out in Test Tubes: an empty tube in the Queen slot takes the Queen out, empty tubes in the feed slot fill with ants (up to 1,000 each), and the Colony page's Take out buttons do the same from your inventory. Then break the Formicarium and put the tubes into a new one. Ants left inside a broken Formicarium are lost.
guide.antcolonies.start.title: Getting Started
guide.antcolonies.upgrades.text:
Upgrades go in a screen's upgrade slots; shift-clicking one puts it there. Each block takes the kinds it can use: the slot's tooltip, and JEI or EMI, tell which.
The Colony Upgrade Station makes species upgrades from an Upgrade Base and a species' signature material. They work only for that species, in Foraging Sites.

research.antcolonies.knightmetal.hint: The metal of the goblin knights' armour.
research.antcolonies.kyanite.hint: A blue gem that grows in blades.
research.antcolonies.lapis.hint: A deep blue stone enchanters use.
research.antcolonies.lumium.hint: Tin and silver that shine with glowstone.
research.antcolonies.malarite.hint: A dark gem from a land of endless night.
research.antcolonies.mithril.hint: A pale metal from the very bottom of the world.
research.antcolonies.moldavite.hint: Green glass made where a star fell.
research.antcolonies.monazite.hint: A purple sand full of rare elements.
research.antcolonies.neptunium.hint: A sea-green metal only fishermen find.
research.antcolonies.netherite.hint: The Nether's ancient metal, as scrap or as an ingot.
research.antcolonies.novite.hint: A violet metal that fell from the sky.
research.antcolonies.opal.hint: A milky gem with fire inside.
research.antcolonies.ostrum.hint: A dusky metal from the red planet.
research.antcolonies.platinum.hint: A rare white metal, heavier than gold.
research.antcolonies.redstone.hint: Red dust that carries a signal.
research.antcolonies.regalium.hint: A golden crystal traders of the deep value.
research.antcolonies.rogdorium.hint: A pale crystal from under the deepest rock of the deep.
research.antcolonies.sal_ammoniac.hint: A pale crystal alchemists dissolve things in.
research.antcolonies.salt.hint: White dust from dry salt pans.
research.antcolonies.saltpeter.hint: A white dust that makes powder burn.
research.antcolonies.signalum.hint: Copper and silver, red with redstone.
research.antcolonies.silicon.hint: Quartz and sand, smelted to a grey wafer.
research.antcolonies.silver.hint: A bright white metal, found with lead.
research.antcolonies.soulium.hint: A brown dust that holds what a mob leaves behind.
research.antcolonies.starcore.hint: A warm stone like a small ember.
research.antcolonies.starlit_diamond.hin: A diamond that keeps the starlight.
research.antcolonies.starmetal.hint: Iron that lay under the stars too long.
research.antcolonies.steeleaf.hint: A leaf as hard as steel.
research.antcolonies.thioquartz.hint: A yellow-green quartz that smells of sulfur.
research.antcolonies.tin.hint: A soft white metal that makes bronze with copper.
research.antcolonies.titanium.hint: A light, hard metal from another world.
research.antcolonies.topaz.hint: An orange gem, clear and hard.
research.antcolonies.tungsten.hint: A violet-grey metal that will not melt.
research.antcolonies.turquoise.hint: A blue-green stone that grows near copper.
research.antcolonies.unobtainium.hint: A violet metal from the End that should not exist.
research.antcolonies.uraninite.hint: A raw green ore that holds a charge.
research.antcolonies.uranium.hint: A raw ore that glows green.
research.antcolonies.utherium.hint: A blood red crystal from deep under the world.
research.antcolonies.vibranium.hint: A teal metal that hums, from the Nether.
research.antcolonies.white_diamond.hint: A diamond without a trace of colour.
research.antcolonies.xychorium.hint: A gem that comes in five colours.
research.antcolonies.zanite.hint: A purple gemstone from the sky.
research.antcolonies.zinc.hint: A pale metal that makes brass with copper.
species.antcolonies.abyssal.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Lapis Ants that dives for the ocean monuments' treasures: prismarine, sea lanterns and sponges.
species.antcolonies.alexandrite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed alexandrite. Violet in one light and green in another; bring alexandrite. They find few.
species.antcolonies.allthemodium.desc: Netherite Ants fed allthemodium, the gold-bright metal under the deepest stone. They breed slowly and live long; very slowly, they bring allthemodium.
species.antcolonies.aluminum.desc: Light, quick Iron Ants fed aluminum. Bring aluminum.
species.antcolonies.amber.desc: Stone Ants fed amber. Honey gold; bring amber for Thaumaturge, with cinnabar and quicksilver.
species.antcolonies.ambrosium.desc: Coal Ants fed ambrosium shards, the glowing fuel of the Aether. Bring ambrosium.
species.antcolonies.amethyst.desc: Living geodes that glow violet in the dark. Prefer to live underground.
species.antcolonies.ammolite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed ammolite, old sea shells turned to gem. Bring ammolite. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.anglesite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed anglesite crystals from the End. Slow; bring anglesite for Extreme Reactors.
species.antcolonies.antimony.desc: Iron Ants fed antimony, a brittle white metal. Bring antimony for Modern Industrialization.
species.antcolonies.aquamarine.desc: Lapis Ants fed aquamarine. Sea blue; bring aquamarine.
species.antcolonies.arcane.desc: Amethyst Ants fed arcane crystals. Slow; bring crystals and a few runes for Forbidden and Arcanus, and a rare piece of stellarite.
species.antcolonies.arkenium.desc: Iron Ants fed arkenium plates, the heavy metal of the Aether. Slow; bring arkenium plates.
species.antcolonies.army.desc: Nomad hunters of plains and savannas that live anywhere. At a Hunting Ground they swarm zombies, skeletons and spiders, and feed on the catch.
species.antcolonies.azure_silver.desc: Chorus Ants fed azure silver, the blue metal of the End that only a netherite pickaxe breaks. As slow as Diamond Ants; bring azure silver for Silent Gear.
species.antcolonies.badlands.desc: Rust-red ants of the badlands. Bring red sand and terracotta in all the badlands colors, and a little gold.
species.antcolonies.baker.desc: Farmer Ants fed cake. Dusted white with flour. They forage wheat, sugar and eggs, and bake at a Harvesting Site: bread, cookies, pumpkin pie and now and then a whole cake.
species.antcolonies.bauxite.desc: Iron Ants fed bauxite, the red earth aluminum comes from. Bring bauxite dust.
species.antcolonies.benitoite.desc: Lapis Ants fed benitoite crystals from the Nether. Bring benitoite for Extreme Reactors.
species.antcolonies.bioethanol.desc: Water Ants fed bioethanol. They give Bioethanol Droplets: fuel grown, not drilled.
species.antcolonies.biofuel.desc: Water Ants fed biofuel. Dark green crops, and Biofuel Droplets: fuel pressed from plants, with no press.
species.antcolonies.black_diamond.desc: Coal Ants fed black diamonds. Bring black diamonds. They find few.
species.antcolonies.black_quartz.desc: Coal Ants fed black quartz. Bring black quartz for Actually Additions.
species.antcolonies.blaze_ember_fuel.des: Polymorphic Ants fed Blaze Ember Fuel. Their crops glow like embers: refined fuel for Just Dire Things, slowly.
species.antcolonies.blazegold.desc: Ferricore Ants fed blazegold. Slow; bring raw blazegold for Just Dire Things.
species.antcolonies.blood.desc: Water Ants fed blood. Dark red crops, and Blood Droplets for EvilCraft with nothing harmed.
species.antcolonies.blossom.desc: Pink ants of cherry groves and flower meadows. Bring flowers for every dye, petals, cherry wood and honeycomb.
species.antcolonies.bookworm.desc: Wood Ants fed books. They chew wood into paper and cannot stop reading. Paper, books and bookshelves come home, and now and then a Bottle o' Enchanting from something they learned.
species.antcolonies.bort.desc: Deepslate Ants fed bort, the rough diamond of Silent Gear. Bring bort.
species.antcolonies.brass.desc: Zinc Ants fed brass. They bring brass ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.brine.desc: Water Ants fed brine. Pale-cropped ants that give Brine Droplets for Mekanism's chemistry.
species.antcolonies.bronze.desc: Tin Ants fed bronze. They bring bronze ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.bullet.desc: Jungle Ants fed gunpowder. Their sting fells creepers and witches: gunpowder, redstone and glowstone come home, and from stage 3 phantom membranes.
species.antcolonies.calorite.desc: Ostrum Ants fed calorite, the red metal of the hottest planet. They bring a few calorite nuggets an hour.
species.antcolonies.canola_oil.desc: Water Ants fed canola oil. Bright yellow crops, and Canola Oil Droplets for Actually Additions.
species.antcolonies.carnelian.desc: Redstone Ants fed carnelian. Warm orange-red; bring carnelian. They find few.
species.antcolonies.carpenter.desc: Wood Ants fed crafting tables. Big, dark and handy: they carry their work on their backs. Planks, sticks and ladders come home, later barrels and scaffolding.
species.antcolonies.celestigem.desc: Blazegold Ants fed celestigems. Rarer than diamonds from ants too; bring celestigems for Just Dire Things.
species.antcolonies.certus.desc: Amethyst Ants fed certus quartz. Bring certus quartz for Applied Energistics, and fluix at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.chaos.desc: Amethyst Ants fed chaos essence. Restless and pale; bring chaos essence for Silent's Gems.
species.antcolonies.chicken.desc: Army Ants fed feathers. Small, white and easily startled. They forage eggs and seeds, and bring chicken and feathers from a Hunting Ground. They cannot fly either.
species.antcolonies.chimerite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed chimerite. Bring chimerite, vinteum dust and topaz for Ars Magica, and a rare moonstone or sunstone.
species.antcolonies.chocolate.desc: Water Ants fed chocolate. Brown-cropped ants that give Chocolate Droplets for Create's kitchens.
species.antcolonies.chorus.desc: Pale violet ants of the End's outer islands. Bring end stone, chorus fruit and purpur; fed eyes of ender in the End they become Ender Ants.
species.antcolonies.cinnabar.desc: Redstone Ants fed cinnabar, the red ore of quicksilver. Bring cinnabar and the sulfur found beside it.
species.antcolonies.citrine.desc: Gold Ants fed citrine. Bring citrine. They find few.
species.antcolonies.cloggrum.desc: Iron Ants fed cloggrum, the dull metal of the Undergarden. Bring cloggrum.
species.antcolonies.cloud_seed.desc: Water Ants fed cloud seed. They give Cloud Seed Droplets for Ender IO's weather machines.
species.antcolonies.coal.desc: Soot-black ants evolved from Stone Ants fed coal. A steady supply of fuel for furnaces and Generators.
species.antcolonies.common.desc: The starting species of plains and forests. Brings back soil, seeds, sticks and odds and ends.
species.antcolonies.constantan.desc: Copper Ants fed constantan. They bring constantan ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.copper.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed copper. Their shells go green with age, like old roofs.
species.antcolonies.corrobonite.desc: Zanite Ants fed corrobonite crystals from the Aether. Very slow; bring corrobonite.
species.antcolonies.cow.desc: Army Ants fed milk. Black and white and very calm. They graze; what they bring from a Hunting Ground looks a lot like beef and leather; and at a Liquid Chamber they give Milk Droplets. Nobody has heard one moo.
species.antcolonies.creosote.desc: Lava Ants fed creosote oil. Tar-dark crops, and Creosote Oil Droplets for treated wood and rails.
species.antcolonies.crimson.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Fire Ants that grows Nether fungus. Tends Harvesting Sites for food, wart and shroomlight.
species.antcolonies.crimson_iron.desc: Iron Ants fed crimson iron, the red metal of the Nether. Bring crimson iron for Silent Gear.
species.antcolonies.crude_oil.desc: Water Ants fed crude oil. Black-cropped ants that give Crude Oil Droplets: oil with no pump, a little at a time.
species.antcolonies.dark_gem.desc: Coal Ants fed dark gems. Black as their find; bring dark gems for EvilCraft.
species.antcolonies.deepsilver.desc: Iron Ants fed deepsilver, the blue-grey silver of the Starlight dimension. Bring deepsilver.
species.antcolonies.deepslate.desc: Stone Ants that went down. Live best underground; bring deepslate, tuff, dripstone and glow lichen.
species.antcolonies.demonite.desc: Soul Ants fed hellforged metal. They bring raw demonite, the ore of Neo Vitae's last dungeon, about as often as Netherite Ants bring scrap.
species.antcolonies.desert.desc: Fast, heat-loving ants of deserts and badlands. Bring sand, sandstone and cactus, and sometimes gold.
species.antcolonies.desh.desc: Iron Ants fed desh, the orange metal of other worlds. Slow; bring raw desh.
species.antcolonies.dew_of_the_void.desc: Nutrient Ants fed dew of the void. They give Dew of the Void Droplets for Ender IO's crystals.
species.antcolonies.diamond.desc: Rare crystal ants grown from Gold or Lapis lines. Bring diamond fragments; whole diamonds at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.diesel.desc: Oil Ants fed diesel. Yellow-green crops, and Diesel Droplets for generators and for turbofuel.
species.antcolonies.dimensional.desc: Lapis Ants fed dimensional shards. Bring shards for RFTools from wherever they dig.
species.antcolonies.draconium.desc: Diamond Ants fed draconium. Very slow; bring draconium dust for Draconic Evolution.
species.antcolonies.dragon.desc: Ender Ants fed the dragon's breath in the End. Black and violet, they glow faintly and bring the End's treasures: pearls, purpur, shulker shells and the dragon's breath itself.
species.antcolonies.eclipse_alloy.desc: Celestigem Ants fed eclipse alloy. They bring raw eclipse alloy about as often as Netherite Ants bring scrap.
species.antcolonies.eclipse_ember_fuel.d: Voidflame Ants fed Eclipse Ember Fuel. Dark crops with a pale fire inside: the last fuel of Just Dire Things, a bucket in about four hours.
species.antcolonies.electrum.desc: Gold Ants fed electrum. They bring electrum ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.emerald.desc: Gem-backed ants evolved from Diamond Ants. Bring emerald fragments.
species.antcolonies.ender.desc: Amethyst Ants changed by eyes of ender. Black with violet eyes; bring end stone, chorus and ender pearls, and very rarely shulker shells.
species.antcolonies.enderium.desc: Lead Ants fed enderium. Slower than Platinum Ants; they bring enderium nuggets and dust.
species.antcolonies.ether.desc: Water Ants fed ether. Pale mint crops, and Ether Droplets from the rivers of the Starlight dimension.
species.antcolonies.excavator.desc: A hybrid of Desert and Deepslate Ants that digs like an archaeologist: bones, pottery sherds, ancient seeds, even sniffer eggs.
species.antcolonies.experience.desc: Water Ants fed liquid experience. Their crops glow green: Experience Droplets, a point at a time.
species.antcolonies.farmer.desc: Leafcutters that grow fungus gardens. Their Harvesting Sites feed the whole colony.
species.antcolonies.ferricore.desc: Iron Ants fed ferricore. Bring raw ferricore for Just Dire Things, with no goo to feed.
species.antcolonies.fire.desc: Desert Ants fed blaze powder. They glow like coals and bring the Nether's fuels: blaze powder, magma, wart and quartz.
species.antcolonies.fire_water.desc: Hootch Ants fed fire water. They give Fire Water Droplets, a strong fuel for Ender IO.
species.antcolonies.firestone.desc: Fire Ants fed raw firestone, the burning stone under the Nether's lava. Now and then they bring one.
species.antcolonies.fisher.desc: Shore Ants fed fishing rods. A yellow rain hat, a rod over the shoulder and all the patience in the world. Cod and salmon come home, then tropical fish and pufferfish, and now and then an old boot.
species.antcolonies.fluorite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed fluorite. Bring fluorite for Mekanism's or MachinaOpus's chemistry.
species.antcolonies.fluxite.desc: Lapis Ants fed fluxite. Bright pink; bring fluxite for Oritech.
species.antcolonies.force.desc: Gold Ants fed force gems. Bring force gems for Forcecraft.
species.antcolonies.froststeel.desc: Cloggrum Ants fed froststeel, the cold metal of the Undergarden's ice. Slow; bring froststeel.
species.antcolonies.fuel.desc: Oil Ants fed fuel. Ochre crops, and Fuel Droplets to fill a rocket for Stellaris.
species.antcolonies.garnet.desc: Redstone Ants fed garnets. Dark red; bring garnets.
species.antcolonies.gold.desc: Gilded ants of hot lands. Their nuggets come compressed to ingots with Processing upgrades.
species.antcolonies.gravitite.desc: Arkenium Ants fed gravitite plates, the metal that falls upward. Slow; bring gravitite plates.
species.antcolonies.harvester.desc: A hybrid of Farmer and Savanna Ants, after the real seed-storing harvester ants. Tend Harvesting Sites for crops of every kind.
species.antcolonies.heavy_oil.desc: Oil Ants fed heavy oil. Tar-brown crops, and Heavy Oil Droplets with no refinery.
species.antcolonies.heavy_water.desc: Water Ants fed heavy water. Deep blue crops and a slow trickle of Heavy Water Droplets for reactors.
species.antcolonies.heliodor.desc: Gold Ants fed heliodor. Bring heliodor. They find few.
species.antcolonies.honey.desc: Honeypot Ants fed liquid honey. All crop, they give Honey Droplets for pipes, basins and hives.
species.antcolonies.honeypot.desc: A hybrid of Blossom and Farmer Ants. Some workers swell into living honey jars: honey, sugar and comb. Tends Harvesting Sites.
species.antcolonies.hootch.desc: Water Ants fed hootch. They hold their drink, and give Hootch Droplets for Ender IO.
species.antcolonies.hydrogen.desc: Water Ants fed hydrogen. Their crops fizz bright blue: Hydrogen Droplets for Stellaris, with no electrolyzer.
species.antcolonies.ice_shard.desc: Snow Ants fed ice shards. Slow; bring ice shards for Ad Astra.
species.antcolonies.iesnium.desc: Silver Ants fed iesnium, the metal Occultism hides in netherrack. They see it without a third eye, but find it as rarely as diamonds; bring iesnium.
species.antcolonies.inferium.desc: Stone Ants fed inferium essence. Bring essence for Mystical Agriculture, and prosperity shards from stage 2.
species.antcolonies.inferno.desc: Fire Ants fed blaze powder. They hunt the Nether's fire: blaze rods, magma cream, ghast tears and wither skulls.
species.antcolonies.infinity.desc: Deepslate Ants fed grains of infinity. They scrape the bedrock for the grey dust Ender IO starts with.
species.antcolonies.invar.desc: Nickel Ants fed invar. They bring invar ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.iolite.desc: Lapis Ants fed iolite. Violet-blue; bring iolite. They find few.
species.antcolonies.iridium.desc: Platinum Ants fed iridium, the hardest of the white metals. As slow as Diamond Ants; bring iridium.
species.antcolonies.iron.desc: Evolved from Stone Ants fed iron. Their armoured bodies shine like polished metal.
species.antcolonies.ironwood.desc: Wood Ants fed ironwood, the living metal of the Twilight Forest. Bring raw ironwood and liveroot.
species.antcolonies.jungle.desc: Busy ants of the jungle canopy. Bring jungle wood, bamboo, vines, cocoa and melon.
species.antcolonies.knightmetal.desc: Iron Ants fed knightmetal. Very slow; bring armor shards, nine to an ingot of knightmetal.
species.antcolonies.kyanite.desc: Lapis Ants fed kyanite. Bring kyanite. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.lapis.desc: Deep blue ants with lapis plates. Gather lapis lazuli.
species.antcolonies.latex.desc: Water Ants fed latex. Milky-cropped ants that give Latex Droplets for Industrial Foregoing.
species.antcolonies.lava.desc: Honeypot Ants fed lava in the Nether. Their glowing crops hold lava: slow, hungry makers of Lava Droplets.
species.antcolonies.lead.desc: Heavy, slow Iron Ants fed lead. Bring lead.
species.antcolonies.leafcutter.desc: Farmer Ants fed shears. They hold cut leaves over their heads like sails and grow fungus on them at a Harvesting Site.
species.antcolonies.lignite.desc: Coal Ants fed lignite coal. Bring lignite for Modern Industrialization's boilers.
species.antcolonies.liquid_blaze.desc: Lava Ants fed liquid blaze. Their crops burn gold: Liquid Blaze Droplets for MachinaOpus's Blaze Crucible, slowly.
species.antcolonies.liquid_chorus.desc: Water Ants fed liquid chorus. They give Liquid Chorus Droplets for Integrated Dynamics.
species.antcolonies.liquid_etherium.desc: Water Ants fed liquid etherium. Pale, glowing crops, and Liquid Etherium Droplets for Ars Magica.
species.antcolonies.liquid_force.desc: Water Ants fed liquid force. Their crops glow yellow: Liquid Force Droplets for Forcecraft.
species.antcolonies.liquid_starlight.des: Water Ants fed liquid starlight. Their crops shine by night and by day: Liquid Starlight Droplets for Astral Sorcery.
species.antcolonies.liquid_sunshine.desc: Hootch Ants fed liquid sunshine. Their crops shine: Liquid Sunshine Droplets for Ender IO.
species.antcolonies.lumium.desc: Tin Ants fed lumium. They glow, and bring lumium ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.malarite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed malarite. Bring malarite for Eternal Starlight.
species.antcolonies.mechanical_miner.des: A hybrid of Stone and Redstone Ants: tireless miners that bring a bit of everything.
species.antcolonies.menril_resin.desc: Water Ants fed menril resin. Pale blue crops, and Menril Resin Droplets for Integrated Dynamics.
species.antcolonies.mithril.desc: Deepslate Ants fed mithril, the pale metal at the bottom of the world. They bring raw mithril about as often as Netherite Ants bring scrap.
species.antcolonies.moldavite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed moldavite. Bottle green; bring moldavite. They find few.
species.antcolonies.molybdenum.desc: Iron Ants fed molybdenum, the metal that hardens MachinaOpus's steel. Bring molybdenum.
species.antcolonies.monazite.desc: Redstone Ants fed monazite. Slow; bring monazite dust for Modern Industrialization.
species.antcolonies.naphtha.desc: Oil Ants fed light naphtha. Pale straw crops, and Light Naphtha Droplets for Oritech's plastics.
species.antcolonies.neptunium.desc: Reef Ants fed neptunium, the sea metal only fishing brings up. Now and then they bring a nugget.
species.antcolonies.netherite.desc: The end of the line: heat-forged ants of the Nether. Very slow, very hungry, and the only ants that find netherite.
species.antcolonies.nickel.desc: Iron Ants fed nickel. Bring nickel.
species.antcolonies.novite.desc: Desh Ants fed novite, the violet metal of fallen stars. Very slow; bring raw novite for Stellaris.
species.antcolonies.nutrient_distillatio: Water Ants fed nutrient distillation. Olive crops, and Nutrient Distillation Droplets for Ender IO.
species.antcolonies.obsidian.desc: A hybrid of Stone and Fire Ants: where lava meets stone. Bring obsidian, basalt and magma; crying obsidian at stage 3.
species.antcolonies.opal.desc: Amethyst Ants fed opals. Milk white; bring opals. They find few.
species.antcolonies.osmium.desc: Stone Ants fed osmium, which takes a diamond pickaxe to mine. Slow; bring osmium for Mekanism's machines.
species.antcolonies.ostrum.desc: Desh Ants fed ostrum, the dusky metal of the red planet. Very slow; bring ostrum for Ad Astra.
species.antcolonies.oxygen.desc: Water Ants fed Fluid Cells of oxygen. Pale, fizzing crops, and Oxygen Droplets for Stellaris: air to take along.
species.antcolonies.pale.desc: Ghost-white ants of the pale garden. Bring pale oak, pale moss and resin, and the odd eyeblossom.
species.antcolonies.party.desc: Common Ants fed firework rockets. Loud colours and no sense of bedtime. They bring rockets, note blocks and cake, and at stage 3 the odd music disc.
species.antcolonies.pearl.desc: Amethyst Ants fed pearls. Bring pearls. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.peridot.desc: Amethyst Ants fed peridot. Lime green; bring peridot.
species.antcolonies.pig.desc: Army Ants fed carrots on sticks. Pink, round and fond of mud. They root up carrots, potatoes and beetroot, and bring porkchops from a Hunting Ground. They will follow a carrot anywhere.
species.antcolonies.pink_slime.desc: Water Ants fed pink slime. Their crops wobble pink: Pink Slime Droplets for Industrial Foregoing, slowly.
species.antcolonies.pirate.desc: Shore Ants fed gold. Weathered raiders in black hats with a nose for buried treasure: sand, gold nuggets, a rare emerald and nautilus shell, and once in a long while a Heart of the Sea. Arr.
species.antcolonies.plant_oil.desc: Water Ants fed plant oil. They give Plant Oil Droplets: oil pressed from seeds, with no press.
species.antcolonies.platinum.desc: Gold Ants fed platinum, a rare white metal. As slow as Diamond Ants; bring platinum.
species.antcolonies.polymorphic_fluid.de: Water Ants fed polymorphic fluid. Red crops, and Polymorphic Fluid Droplets for Just Dire Things.
species.antcolonies.portal_fluid.desc: Polymorphic Ants fed Portal Fluid. Bubbling green crops, and Portal Fluid Droplets for the Portal Gun.
species.antcolonies.rabbit.desc: Army Ants fed rabbit hide. Long ears, a white tail and a very large brood. They nibble up carrots and dandelions, and bring raw rabbit and hide from a Hunting Ground, and from stage 3, rarely, a lucky foot.
species.antcolonies.redstone.desc: Glowing red ants that hum with energy. Gather redstone and, at higher stages, glowstone.
species.antcolonies.reef.desc: A hybrid of Shore and Jungle Ants, as bright as a coral reef. Bring living coral blocks and fans of all five colors.
species.antcolonies.regalium.desc: Amethyst Ants fed regalium crystals from the Undergarden. Bright as coins; bring regalium. They find few.
species.antcolonies.resin.desc: Water Ants fed resin. Amber-cropped ants that give Resin Droplets for Thermal's machines.
species.antcolonies.rocket_fuel.desc: Hootch Ants fed rocket fuel. Drab olive crops, and Rocket Fuel Droplets for Ender IO.
species.antcolonies.rogdorium.desc: Froststeel Ants fed rogdorium, the pale crystal under the Undergarden's deepest rock. Very slow; bring rogdorium nuggets.
species.antcolonies.rose_quartz.desc: Amethyst Ants fed rose quartz. Pink; bring rose quartz. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.rubber.desc: Wood Ants fed rubber that tap rubber trees. Bring rubber logs and saplings; at a Harvesting Site they bring rubber for MachinaOpus's cables.
species.antcolonies.ruby.desc: Amethyst Ants fed rubies. Deep red; bring rubies.
species.antcolonies.sal_ammoniac.desc: Amethyst Ants fed sal ammoniac crystals. Pale and sharp-smelling; bring sal ammoniac for Theurgy.
species.antcolonies.sal_ammoniac_solutio: Water Ants fed liquid sal ammoniac. They give Sal Ammoniac Droplets, the solvent of Theurgy's alchemy.
species.antcolonies.salt.desc: Desert Ants fed salt that work dry salt pans. Pale as the crust they dig; bring salt.
species.antcolonies.saltpeter.desc: Desert Ants fed saltpeter that scrape it from dry sand. Bring saltpeter.
species.antcolonies.sap.desc: Water Ants fed sap. They give Sap Droplets: tree sap with no tapping.
species.antcolonies.sapphire.desc: Lapis Ants fed sapphires. Clear blue; bring sapphires.
species.antcolonies.savanna.desc: Large, bold ants of the savanna. Strip acacia, gather grain and pick over what the herds leave: bones, feathers, hide.
species.antcolonies.sculk.desc: A hybrid of Deepslate and Soul Ants from the deep dark. Bring sculk, sensors and catalysts, and the rare echo shard.
species.antcolonies.sheep.desc: Army Ants fed wool. Woolly ants that follow each other everywhere. They forage wool in the colours sheep come in, pink very rarely, and bring wool and mutton from a Hunting Ground.
species.antcolonies.shore.desc: Beachcombing ants that work the tideline. Bring sand, kelp and ink, then prismarine and, rarely, nautilus shells.
species.antcolonies.signalum.desc: Redstone Ants fed signalum. They bring signalum ready mixed: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.silicon.desc: Desert Ants fed silicon. They sift it from the sand ready smelted, grey and brittle, for circuits and solar panels.
species.antcolonies.silver.desc: Lead Ants fed silver; they shine like mirrors. Bring silver.
species.antcolonies.snow.desc: Pale ants of the frozen north that thrive where others freeze. Gather snow and ice.
species.antcolonies.soul.desc: Fire Ants touched by soul fire. Live best in the Nether; bring soul sand, basalt and blackstone, and ghast tears.
species.antcolonies.soul_lava.desc: Lava Ants fed soul lava. Their crops burn blue: Soul Lava Droplets from The Other, slowly.
species.antcolonies.soulium.desc: Soul Ants fed soulium dust. Bring soulium for Mystical Agriculture.
species.antcolonies.starcore.desc: Redstone Ants fed starcores. Warm as embers; bring starcores for Eternal Starlight. They find few.
species.antcolonies.starlit_diamond.desc: Diamond Ants fed starlit diamonds. Bring starlit diamonds for Eternal Starlight. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.starmetal.desc: Iron Ants fed starmetal. Slow; bring raw starmetal for Astral Sorcery, whatever the sky is doing.
species.antcolonies.steel.desc: Iron Ants fed steel. They bring steel with no furnace: nuggets, dust and the odd ingot.
species.antcolonies.steeleaf.desc: Ironwood Ants fed steeleaf. Slow; bring the Twilight Forest's steel-hard leaves, which no one can craft.
species.antcolonies.stone.desc: Tough mountain ants that tunnel through rock. Bring stone, gravel and the odd mineral; the start of every mineral line.
species.antcolonies.sulfur.desc: Fire Ants fed sulfur that live around hot vents. Bring sulfur without mining or refining for it.
species.antcolonies.sulfuric_acid.desc: Water Ants fed sulfuric acid. Their crops hold it somehow: Sulfuric Acid Droplets for ore processing.
species.antcolonies.swamp.desc: Mud-coated ants of swamps and mangroves. Bring clay, mud, sugar cane and lily pads, and in time slime.
species.antcolonies.tanzanite.desc: Lapis Ants fed tanzanite. Deep blue-violet; bring tanzanite. They find few.
species.antcolonies.tea.desc: Water Ants fed Builder's Tea. They give Builder's Tea Droplets, a fluid Create has no bucket for.
species.antcolonies.thioquartz.desc: Amethyst Ants fed thioquartz. Bring thioquartz shards for Eternal Starlight. They find few.
species.antcolonies.time_fluid.desc: Polymorphic Ants fed Time Fluid. Their crops glow green and they are never late: a bucket in about four hours.
species.antcolonies.tin.desc: Copper Ants fed tin: together they make bronze. Bring tin.
species.antcolonies.titanium.desc: Iron Ants fed titanium, light and hard. Bring titanium.
species.antcolonies.topaz.desc: Gold Ants fed topaz. Orange and clear; bring topaz.
species.antcolonies.trap_jaw.desc: Swamp Ants fed slime balls. Their jaws snap shut faster than anything: slimes, drowned and the odd guardian.
species.antcolonies.tungsten.desc: Iron Ants fed tungsten, the metal that will not melt. Slow; bring tungsten.
species.antcolonies.turbofuel.desc: Diesel Ants fed turbofuel. Slate-blue crops and a slow trickle of Turbofuel Droplets, Oritech's best fuel.
species.antcolonies.turquoise.desc: Copper Ants fed turquoise. Blue-green; bring turquoise. They find few.
species.antcolonies.unobtainium.desc: Vibranium Ants fed unobtainium, the violet metal of the End. They breed slowly and live long; only an End Foraging Site brings them to what cannot be obtained.
species.antcolonies.uraninite.desc: Redstone Ants fed raw uraninite, the ore that charges Powah's machines. Bring raw uraninite.
species.antcolonies.uranium.desc: Lead Ants fed raw uranium. They glow green in the dark; bring uranium.
species.antcolonies.utherium.desc: Redstone Ants fed utherium crystals from the Undergarden. Blood red; bring utherium. They find few.
species.antcolonies.vibranium.desc: Allthemodium Ants fed vibranium, the humming teal metal of the Nether. They breed slowly and live long; only a Nether Foraging Site brings them to their metal.
species.antcolonies.virulent_mix.desc: Water Ants fed virulent mix. Purple crops, and Virulent Mix Droplets from the Undergarden's pools.
species.antcolonies.voidflame_fuel.desc: Blaze Ember Ants fed Voidflame Fuel. Their crops burn teal: a bucket of refined fuel in an hour and a half.
species.antcolonies.warped.desc: Teal ants of the Nether's fungus forests, at home in its heat. Bring netherrack, fungi and nether wart; fed blaze powder in the Nether they become Fire Ants.
species.antcolonies.water.desc: Honeypot Ants fed water. Their crops are full of it, always: at a Liquid Chamber they give Water Droplets and nothing else.
species.antcolonies.weaver.desc: Jungle Ants fed string. They sew leaves together with silk: string and leaves come home, now and then a whole cobweb.
species.antcolonies.white_diamond.desc: Diamond Ants fed white diamonds. Bring white diamonds. As rare from ants as from the rock.
species.antcolonies.wither.desc: Soul Ants fed a Nether Star in the Nether. Ash-black and grim, they bring soul sand, coal and bones, wither roses and skulls, and very rarely a Nether Star of their own.
species.antcolonies.wood.desc: Red-chested forest builders of the taiga. Gather logs, sticks and saplings.
species.antcolonies.xychorium.desc: Amethyst Ants fed xychorium. Bring its gems in all five colours for XyCraft.
species.antcolonies.zanite.desc: Amethyst Ants fed zanite gemstones from the Aether. Bring zanite.
species.antcolonies.zinc.desc: Copper Ants fed zinc, ready for Create's brass. Bring zinc.

tooltip.antcolonies.ant_test_tube.use: Put into a Formicarium of the same species (or an empty one).
tooltip.antcolonies.army_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.badlands_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.blossom_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.brood.use: Put into a Formicarium of the same species: each adds 4.
tooltip.antcolonies.brood_cluster.placed: Only an anthill's own clusters hatch: placed by you, it is a decoration.
tooltip.antcolonies.brood_cluster.use.eg: Put into the Formicarium of a working colony (a Queen and workers) of its species: adds %s eggs.
tooltip.antcolonies.brood_cluster.use.la: Put into the Formicarium of a working colony (a Queen and workers) of its species: adds %s larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.centrifuge: Spins Liquid Ants' droplets into fluid. Runs on FE; take the fluid with a bucket, a tank or pipes.
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_plate: Only from ants: wild ants leave it, and foraging colonies bring it home.
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_set.ants: Wild ants leave you alone (not if you raid their anthill)
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_set.mixed: Mixed tiers count: the lowest tier decides
tooltip.antcolonies.chitin_shield: Light: raised faster than a wooden shield, and an axe knocks it down for less time.
tooltip.antcolonies.chorus_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.colony_connector: Links its colony to the other colonies with a connector on the same channel: food moves from colonies with food to spare to those that ask for it, and the items its filter names move between their Storage.
tooltip.antcolonies.colony_scanner: Right-click a Formicarium or colony structure for a report.
tooltip.antcolonies.common_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.crystal_ant_food: Food for crystal species (Amethyst, Diamond, Emerald).
tooltip.antcolonies.desert_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.droplet: A drop of %s from Liquid Ants. A Droplet Centrifuge spins it into the fluid.
tooltip.antcolonies.end_foraging_site: End-adapted ants (Chorus, Ender, Dragon) go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back the End's finds. Other ants leave it alone. No power needed.
tooltip.antcolonies.end_trail_pheromone: The scent of a route through the End. A colony living in the End finds it now and then while foraging. Makes the End Foraging Site.
tooltip.antcolonies.evolution_catalyst: Feed to a Formicarium: doubles the chance of the next evolution attempt. The rarer species mutations of the Genetic Laboratory take it too.
tooltip.antcolonies.farmer_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.foraging_site: Workers find their species' resources. Sends finds to Storage; holds 9 stacks when it is full.
tooltip.antcolonies.generator: Burns furnace fuel into FE and gives it to the machines next to it, such as the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_laboratory: Scans materials for research, mutates Queens into researched species and edits their genes. Runs on FE: put a Generator next to it.
tooltip.antcolonies.genetic_sample.use: Cross into a daughter in a Queen Chamber's sample slot.
tooltip.antcolonies.guard_ant.free: Belongs to whoever lets it out
tooltip.antcolonies.guard_ant.trade: Craft it with a name tag to free it for a new owner
tooltip.antcolonies.guard_ant.use: Use on a block to let it out. Right-click it for its screen; sneak-right-click to give the next order. Ant food heals it.
tooltip.antcolonies.hardened_chitin: Only from ants: sometimes from wild ants, and from colonies of stage 2 and up. For tier II upgrades and the Genetic Laboratory.
tooltip.antcolonies.harvesting_site: Farmer Ants grow food here, plus mushrooms, seeds and berries.
tooltip.antcolonies.hunting_ground: Hunter species kill mobs here: the mobs' loot (from their loot tables; none spawn), and food from the catch.
tooltip.antcolonies.infernal_chitin: Only from ants of the Nether: wild ants there and colonies living there. For tier III upgrades and high genetics.
tooltip.antcolonies.infernal_reinforceme: Smithing template: turns Hardened Chitin gear into Infernal with a piece of Infernal Chitin.
tooltip.antcolonies.jungle_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.liquid_chamber: Liquid Ants hang here with full crops and give droplets of their fluid. Only ants that carry a liquid work here.
tooltip.antcolonies.mineral_ant_food: Food for mineral species; their eggs need it.
tooltip.antcolonies.nest_chamber: Brood and housing: eggs at full speed, faster larvae, room for 3,000 adults and 1,500 larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.nether_foraging_site: Nether-adapted ants (Warped, Fire, Inferno, Soul, Netherite, Wither, Crimson) go on expeditions through its little portal and bring back the Nether's finds. Other ants leave it alone. No power needed.
tooltip.antcolonies.nether_trail_pheromo: The scent of a route through the Nether. A colony living in the Nether finds it now and then while foraging. Makes the Nether Foraging Site.
tooltip.antcolonies.nuptial_pheromone: Needed to rear Queens of advanced species.
tooltip.antcolonies.pale_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.

tooltip.antcolonies.queen_chamber: Raises new Queens from the colony's Queen.
tooltip.antcolonies.queen_growing: Growing into stage %s: %s min to go
tooltip.antcolonies.queen_grown: Grown with her colony to stage %s
tooltip.antcolonies.queen_grows: Grows with her colony: %s minutes at a bigger stage (longer for each next one), then two traits +1 (up to level %s)
tooltip.antcolonies.rally_pheromone: On a wild ant: it becomes your Guard Ant. On a Formicarium: the colony gives one. In the air: lists your Guard Ants.
tooltip.antcolonies.reroll_serum: Genetic Laboratory: reroll a trait (never lower) or purge a harmful mutation.
tooltip.antcolonies.royal_jelly: Rich food (400) and the base of Queen rearing.

tooltip.antcolonies.species.mutates: Its Queens can be mutated in the Genetic Laboratory
tooltip.antcolonies.species_upgrade.blan: Made at the Colony Upgrade Station.
tooltip.antcolonies.species_upgrade.effi: Foragers eat less; signature finds more often (%s%%)
tooltip.antcolonies.species_upgrade.proc: Finds come processed (nuggets to ingots, fragments to gems), +%s%%
tooltip.antcolonies.stone_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.storage: More room for what the colony finds, and food room. Hoppers can empty it; Storage Upgrades open more slots.
tooltip.antcolonies.swamp_ant_nest: Place it and ants move in: they tend and harvest crops within 10 blocks and bring the harvest home, for hoppers and pipes to take out.
tooltip.antcolonies.terrarium: An ant terrarium: the heart of a colony. Put a Queen in and feed her. Chambers placed against it, or against its chambers, join the colony. Take the Queen and ants out in Test Tubes before breaking it: what is left inside is lost.
tooltip.antcolonies.test_tube: Holds caught ants. Keep some in your inventory when using Tweezers.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers: Catches wild ants into Test Tubes in your inventory: a tube of the same ants, or an empty one. Also works on wild nests.
tooltip.antcolonies.tweezers.terrarium: On a Formicarium: take workers (sneak: eggs) to start another colony.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.adds_up: Two of a kind in one block add up.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.automation: Storage: pushes its finds into the container below.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.breeding: Faster egg laying and Queen rearing.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.genetic: Cheaper lab work; more mutations in Queen Chambers.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.hunting: Hunting Ground: stronger hunters, more catches, fewer losses.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.population: More ants housed, or more working in one chamber.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.simulation: Formicarium: more offline catch-up (numbers only, no entities).
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.speed: Faster work in chambers, the lab and the Centrifuge, faster larvae.
tooltip.antcolonies.upgrade.storage: Storage: more slots and more food room.

tooltip.antcolonies.void_reinforcement: Smithing template: turns Infernal Chitin gear into Void with a netherite ingot.
